sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000162-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Maple Grove Regional Hospital 162 on June 14, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a MMR share floor of 55%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
